title: lantana camara subsp. portoricensis
intro: Lantana camara subsp. portoricensis, commonly known as the Puerto Rican lantana, is a subspecies of the lantana camara plant, a species of flowering shrub native to the Americas. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Lantana camara subsp. portoricensis include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, which can contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
